service.name: Menu_AnimateSelectionMarkerTiles
behavior: Copies 16 words from ROM table 0x00129DAA plus MENU_SELECTION_MARKER_TILE_OFFSET to VDP_DATA.
Advances MENU_SELECTION_MARKER_TILE_OFFSET by two and wraps it to zero when it reaches 0x38.

conclusion: The former anonymous helper is a frame-gated menu selection-marker tile animation service. Its visual asset identity is left at the table level, while the exact frame count, VDP destination, and offset lifecycle are recorded.
